text:
Alex Kim: Quick sync 10:00 PT next Wed for an APAC-friendly office hours. Need to lock recording consent + how we produce short ad clips. Thoughts?

Priya Shah: Consent is main ask from legal. For public reuse (ads/social) we need an explicit speaker release. Internal-only clips are fine under standard webinar T&Cs.

Marco Ruiz: Ops plan: use Zoom cloud recording, enable auto transcript, then push the processed MP4 + VTT to our S3 assets bucket. Any objections to cloud recording?

Jenna Lee: No objections. Two production asks: (1) auto-export VTT and SRT, (2) automatic 30s/60s clip render so marketing doesn't hand-trim every time. Otherwise I'll own a manual clip queue.

Omar Patel: If we're automating, we should predefine the S3 layout and clip naming. Proposal:
```
/s3/redwood/webinars/2026-11-03-intl-office-hours-v2/
  full-recording.mp4
  full-transcript.vtt
  clips/30s/20261103_160000_speakerA_30s.mp4
  clips/60s/20261103_160000_panel_highlight_60s.mp4
  thumbnails/20261103_thumb.png
  metadata/20261103_metadata.csv
```
Include UTC timestamp + speaker handle in filenames. Metadata CSV can carry clip start/end, speakers, UTMs for routing.

Lina Torres: Lead side: replay watch events should move leads if they watch >50%. Also add UTM parameters per clip variant for paid vs organic so we can attribute conversions. I can wire the watch thresholds into HubSpot.

Alex Kim: Priya, can Legal do a one-click release checkbox on the panelist invite so we don't add friction? Something like: "I grant Redwood permission to use short clips of this session for marketing, including paid promotion."

Priya Shah: Yes. Short checkbox in the invite email + a link to a full release doc. Keep language GDPR-friendly. For EU registrants we'll show a privacy line on the registration form.

Marco Ruiz: Zoom meeting template toggles I'll set: record to cloud (single file), enable audio transcript, host-only recording, disable local recording. I'll create a meeting template and attach it to the meeting ID.

Jenna Lee: For clip pipeline: flow should be 
1) Zoom exports -> S3 raw folder
2) Lambda triggered on object created -> run FFMPEG job to render 30s/60s markers + thumbnails + burn captions if needed
3) Write clip metadata JSON/CSV for marketing to consume
I can own the Lambda function if infra creates the bucket + IAM role.

Omar Patel: I'll provision s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-11-03-intl-office-hours-v2 and add an IAM role for the clip service principal. DM me the lambda ARN and I'll add the trust policy.

Lina Torres: Also: create UTM schema in this form for clips: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=clip&utm_campaign=officehours_20261103&utm_content={clip_variant}. We'll use different content values for 30s/60s/teaser.

Alex Kim: Checklist: 
- [ ] Speaker checkbox on invite (Priya)
- [ ] Zoom template + cloud/transcript enabled (Marco)
- [ ] S3 path + IAM role (Omar)
- [ ] Lambda clipper + thumbnails + ops runbook (Jenna)
- [ ] UTM mapping + HubSpot watch rule (Lina)
- [ ] Registration privacy copy for EU (Priya)

Priya Shah: I'll draft the checkbox copy: "By accepting this invite you grant Redwood permission to use brief clips of this session for marketing purposes (including paid ads). See full release: <link>." Will add GDPR note on registration page.

Marco Ruiz: Template created and shared in #eng-infra (internal link provided). I'll set host-only recording and transcript on that template.

Omar Patel: S3 path provisioned: s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-11-03-intl-office-hours-v2. IAM role created and DM'ed to Jenna.

Jenna Lee: I'll stand up the Lambda clipper tomorrow. Will also add a fallback manual trimming doc in the ops runbook.

Lina Torres: HubSpot rule: if replay_watch_pct >= 50 and email_domain != internal, set lifecycle stage to MQL. I'll also add event mapping so clips trigger different nurture flows.

Alex Kim: Can someone add short copy on the registration page reminding attendees this will be recorded and may be used for clips? Keep it short and clear for EU.

Priya Shah: Draft for registration: "This session will be recorded and may be used for marketing clips. By registering, you consent to this use." Concise and GDPR-friendly.

Zoom Bot: Meeting created by Alex Kim: "APAC-friendly Office Hours". Cloud recording enabled. Transcript enabled.

Alex Kim: Great. If there are no objections we'll proceed with above. :thumbsup:

Jenna Lee: No objections. :white_check_mark:

Marco Ruiz: Green light from infra.

Omar Patel: All set on infra.

Zoom Bot: Recording processed and exported to s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-11-03-intl-office-hours-v2/full-recording.mp4. Transcript at full-transcript.vtt.
